final.name: Caption length / verbosity (word count, clause count)
final.audit_justification: It scores raw word/clause count and explicitly disclaims judging whether the length helps or hurts the joke, making it a structural footprint rather than a quality call, though a fuller setup-plus-payoff structure could plausibly reflect real craft investment.

final.name: Kinship framing and first-name familiar address
final.audit_justification: It scores presence of family/kinship terms and address-by-name while explicitly barring judgment of whether the framing is warm, relatable, or funny, making it a pure subject-matter marker.
final.upstream_parent: submitter's life stage and household composition (age cohort, parenthood, marital status)

final.name: Density of identifiable wordplay/puns
final.audit_justification: It scores how much of the humor rests on puns as a density/genre marker without evaluating whether the wordplay is executed well, though wordplay fluency could plausibly track real comic facility.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores the presence and legibility of pun mechanics and stops there -- a judge is told to reward a 'clearly spottable' pun, never whether the wordplay lands, so a caption can max this scale and still be a weak entry. Pun facility does travel with genuine comic skill, so it is mixed.

final.name: Productive ambiguity
final.audit_justification: It rewards a well-judged comic gap over both flat obviousness and mere confusion, a genuine craft evaluation of the joke's construction.

final.name: Time-sensitive framing
final.audit_justification: It counts dates/times/seasonal cues as a topical marker and explicitly disclaims judging whether they are good, so it is a content-tell rather than a quality signal.

final.name: Numeric logistical specificity
final.audit_justification: It counts numerals/measurements/locations only and explicitly refuses to judge whether the specifics improve the caption, though this could stem from the same grounded-detail habit that produces genuinely earned detail.

final.name: Named partisan political figures and outlets
final.audit_justification: It flags naming of real partisan figures/outlets purely as a topic marker while explicitly barring judgment of fairness, aim, or funniness.
final.upstream_parent: the submitter's political community and the assumed politics of the venue's readership

final.name: Payload is not a pun on a depicted object's name
final.audit_justification: It directly penalizes the generic object-name-pun construction as weak craft, a genuine evaluation of joke quality and originality.

final.name: Quietly reassigns power, blame, or who the subject is
final.audit_justification: It rewards a line that forces the reader to recompute who holds power or blame over a flat, expected restatement, a real evaluation of comic sophistication.

final.name: Explicit lexical naming of the depicted object or setting
final.audit_justification: It scores only whether a concrete depicted object is named in the text, explicitly disclaiming any judgment of whether naming helps, spoils, or sharpens the joke.
final.upstream_parent: submitter's familiarity with the contest's conventions (novice one-off entrant vs. repeat veteran entrant)

final.name: Semantic reframe
final.audit_justification: It rewards a wording that genuinely snaps between readings over one that stays literal or produces a strained pun, a real craft judgment of execution.

final.name: Status reversal
final.audit_justification: It rewards a sharp flip in authority or standing over an unchanged relationship, a genuine evaluation of comic craft.

final.name: Specific persona markers (named addressee or verbal tic)
final.audit_justification: It scores presence of a named addressee or idiosyncratic verbal tic as a voice/persona fingerprint rather than evaluating whether the characterization actually works, though genuine voice-craft skill could plausibly underlie it.
final.arbiter_reason: It credits the surface presence of a name, in-group term, or verbal tic rather than whether the characterization actually works, so a high score certifies a stylistic device rather than quality. Real voice-craft plausibly produces those same markers, so mixed.

final.name: Discourse-marker hedge opener (veteran stylistic tic)
final.audit_justification: Its own title names this a 'veteran stylistic tic' -- a discourse-opener habit that fingerprints an experienced repeat entrant rather than judging joke quality, and that same experience plausibly also produces genuinely stronger captions.
final.upstream_parent: author's contest experience / seniority in the submitter community

final.name: Fragmentary minimalism
final.audit_justification: It scores degree of fragmentary/compressed syntax while explicitly disclaiming whether brevity is good or funny, though comedic economy is plausibly a real underlying skill.

final.name: Joke is inert as standalone text; needs the drawing to complete
final.audit_justification: It scores how much of the joke is offloaded onto the unseen drawing while explicitly barring reward or penalty for funniness, though tight text-image integration is plausibly a genuine contest-relevant skill.
final.arbiter_reason: The text explicitly forbids scoring funniness and measures only how much of the gag is offloaded onto the unseen drawing, which is a fact about where the joke's information sits -- and about the text-only judging apparatus -- not about the entry's merit. Caption-image interdependence is nonetheless a real contest skill, so mixed.

final.name: Pun spelled out vs. left compressed for the reader to complete
final.audit_justification: It scores whether a pun's second meaning is spelled out versus left compressed as a presentation-style axis without declaring either pole better, though the underlying scaffolding choice plausibly reflects real comic judgment.
final.arbiter_reason: Both poles are described neutrally with no better end declared, making this a presentation-style axis (scaffolded versus compressed phrasing) rather than an evaluation of the joke. The compression choice plausibly reflects genuine comic judgment, so mixed.

final.name: Question-format framing
final.audit_justification: It scores only the visible interrogative format and explicitly disclaims judging whether it is good, a rhetorical-template marker rather than a quality signal.

final.name: Institutional vocabulary reframes the stakes rather than supplying a pun
final.audit_justification: It rewards institutional vocabulary that recasts the scene's stakes over vocabulary present only because it literally matches a drawn object, an explicit craft evaluation.

final.name: Topical-reference integration
final.audit_justification: It rewards a topical reference essential to the joke's mechanism over a removable name-drop, a genuine evaluation of how well the reference is integrated.

final.name: Enters mid-conversation and implies an unheard prior turn
final.audit_justification: It scores whether the caption reads as a later beat of an implied exchange versus a self-contained opener, a discourse-position marker with no stated good/bad pole, though the in-medias-res move is plausibly a deliberate craft technique.
final.arbiter_reason: It scores discourse position -- later beat of an exchange versus opening line -- with no good pole stated, so a high score reports a structural convention rather than caption quality. In medias res is often a deliberate craft move, so mixed.

final.name: Morbid/dark content (death, injury, loss) as the comic engine
final.audit_justification: It scores how much the humor is built on death, injury, or loss as a subject-matter marker, not an evaluation of whether the dark content is handled well.
final.arbiter_reason: This is a pure subject-matter marker: it scores how far the humor rests on death, injury, or loss while never evaluating whether the dark content is handled well, and the proposer's own examples place the device on both sides of the disagreement. Topic choice by itself is not evidence of craft, so not mixed.

final.name: Earned detail
final.audit_justification: It rewards details that cause or intensify the comic turn over ornamental or interchangeable details, a clear substance/craft evaluation.

final.name: Institutional register
final.audit_justification: It scores how much legal/financial/bureaucratic vocabulary is present while explicitly disclaiming whether that register is good, a register/topic marker rather than a craft evaluation.

final.name: Controlled escalation
final.audit_justification: It rewards escalation that stays coherent with the underlying premise over an abrupt, unrelated pile-on, a genuine evaluation of comic construction.
